pages.title: Loading Plugin

pages.title: Meta Plugin

pages.title: Notify Plugin

pages.title: Ajax Bar
pages.desc: The QAjaxBar Vue component displays a loading bar whenever an Ajax call is in progress.

pages.title: Avatar
pages.desc: The QAvatar Vue component creates an element that can embed a letter, an icon or an image within its shape.

pages.title: Badge
pages.desc: The QBadge Vue component allows you to display information like contextual data that needs to stand out and get noticed.

pages.title: Banner
pages.desc: The QBanner Vue component displays a prominent message and related optional actions.

pages.title: Bar
pages.desc: The QBar Vue component is used to create the top bar on different platforms.

pages.title: Breadcrumbs
pages.desc: The QBreadcrumbs Vue component is a navigational aid for your UI. It allows users to keep track of their location within programs, documents, or websites.

pages.title: Button
pages.desc: The QBtn Vue component is a button with features like shaping, loading state, ripple and more.

pages.title: Dropdown Button
pages.desc: The QBtnDropdown Vue component is used to display dropdown content on a button.

pages.title: Button Group
pages.desc: The QBtnGroup Vue component groups QBtn and QBtnDropdown into a single unit.

pages.title: Button Toggle
pages.desc: The QBtnToggle Vue component is a basic element for user input, similar to QRadio but with buttons.

pages.title: Card
pages.desc: The QCard Vue component is a great way to display important pieces of grouped content. It assists the viewer by containing and organizing information, while also setting up predictable expectations.

pages.title: Carousel
pages.desc: The QCarousel Vue component allows you to display a series of slides, useful for wizards or an image gallery.

pages.title: Chat Message
pages.desc: The QChatMessage Vue component displays a chat entry containing one or more user messages.

pages.title: Checkbox
pages.desc: The QCheckbox Vue component is a checkbox with features like coloring, ripple and indeterminate state.

pages.title: Chip
pages.desc: The QChip Vue component is a simple UI block entity, representing for example more advanced underlying data, such as a contact, but in a compact way.

pages.title: Circular Progress
pages.desc: The QCircularProgress Vue component displays a colored circular loading indicator. The bar can either have a determinate progress, or an indeterminate animation.

pages.title: Color Picker
pages.desc: The QColorPicker Vue component provides a way for the user to input colors.

pages.title: Date Picker
pages.desc: The QDate Vue component provides a method to input dates from Gregorian or Persian calendars.

pages.title: Dialog
pages.desc: The QDialog component provides a UI for modals with functionalities like positioning, styling, maximizing and more.

pages.title: WYSIWYG Editor
pages.desc: The QEditor Vue component is a WYSIWYG editor that enables writing and pasting HTML.

pages.title: Expansion Item
pages.desc: The QExpansionItem Vue component allows visibility toggling like an accordion.

pages.title: Field
pages.desc: The QField Vue component is used to provide common functionality and aspect to form components.

pages.title: File Picker
pages.desc: The QFile Vue component is used as a file picker.

pages.title: Floating Action Button
pages.desc: How to use the QFab component. Floating Action Buttons for your Quasar app.

pages.title: Form
pages.desc: The QForm Vue component renders a form and allows easy validation of child form components like QInput, QSelect or QField.

pages.title: Icon
pages.desc: The QIcon Vue component allows you to insert icons within other components or any other area of your pages.

pages.title: Image
pages.desc: The QImg Vue component makes working with responsive images easy and also adds a nice loading effect to them along with many other features like custom aspect ratio and captions.

pages.title: Infinite Scroll
pages.desc: The QInfiniteScroll Vue component allows you to load new content as the user scrolls the page.

pages.title: Inner Loading
pages.desc: The QInnerLoading Vue component allows you to add a loading indicator within a component in the form of a local overlay.

pages.title: Input
pages.desc: The QInput Vue component is used to capture text input from the user.

pages.title: Intersection
pages.desc: The QIntersection vue component, the wrapper-element counterpart of Quasar's Intersection directive and useIntersection composable.

pages.title: Knob
pages.desc: The QKnob Vue component is used to take a number input through mouse or touch panning.

pages.title: Linear Progress
pages.desc: The QLinearProgress Vue component displays a colored loading bar. The bar can either have a determinate progress or an indeterminate animation.

pages.title: List and List Items
pages.desc: How to use the QList, QItem, QItemSection and QItemLabel Vue components.

pages.title: Markup Table
pages.desc: The QMarkupTable Vue component is a helper wrapper which styles a native table.

pages.title: QMenu
pages.desc: The QMenu Vue component is a convenient way to show menus.

pages.title: No SSR
pages.desc: The QNoSsr Vue component makes it easy to differentiate content between server-side and client-side.

pages.title: Option Group
pages.desc: The QOptionGroup Vue component allows you better control for grouping binary form input components like checkboxes, radios or toggles.

pages.title: Pagination
pages.desc: The QPagination Vue component allows you to easily display a pagination control on a page.

pages.title: Parallax
pages.desc: The QParallax Vue component makes it easy to embed a parallax scrolling effect into a page.

pages.title: Popup Edit
pages.desc: The QPopupEdit Vue component can be used to edit a value 'in place', like for example on a cell in QTable.

pages.title: Popup Proxy
pages.desc: The QPopupProxy is a Vue component that should be used when you need either a QMenu or a QDialog (on smaller screens) to be displayed.

pages.title: Pull to Refresh
pages.desc: The QPullToRefresh Vue component allows the user to pull down in order to refresh or retrieve the newest content on a page.

pages.title: Radio
pages.desc: The QRadio Vue component is a basic element for user input. It can be used to supply a way for the user to pick an option from multiple choices.

pages.title: Range
pages.desc: The QRange Vue component offers a way for the user to select from a sub-range of values between a maximum and maximum value, with optional steps.

pages.title: Rating
pages.desc: The QRating Vue component allows the user to rate items. It's usually known as 'star rating'.

pages.title: Resize Observer
pages.desc: The QResizeObserver Vue component emits a 'resize' event whenever the wrapping DOM element changes its width or height.

pages.title: Responsive
pages.desc: The QResponsive Vue component forces the content to maintain an aspect ratio based on its width.

pages.title: Scroll Area
pages.desc: The QScrollArea Vue component offers a way of customizing the scrollbars for all desktop browsers.

pages.title: Scroll Observer
pages.desc: The QScrollObserver Vue component emits an event whenever the user scrolls the page or the parent scrollable container.

pages.title: Select
pages.desc: The QSelect Vue component has two types of selection - single or multiple. This component opens up a menu for the selection list and action. A filter can also be used for longer lists.

pages.title: Separator
pages.desc: The QSeparator Vue component is used to separate sections of text or other components or elements. It creates a colored line across the width of the parent. It can be horizontal or vertical.

pages.title: Skeleton
pages.desc: The QSkeleton Vue component is used to display a placeholder preview of your content before you load the actual page data.

pages.title: Slide Item
pages.desc: The QSlideItem Vue component is essentially a QItem with two additional slots (left and right) which allows the user to drag it to one of the sides in order to apply a specific action.

pages.title: Slide Transition
pages.desc: The QSlideTransition Vue component slides the encapsulated element up or down, based on its visibility. Works alongside v-show and v-if.

pages.title: Slider
pages.desc: The QSlider Vue component is a great way for the user to specify a number value between a minimum and maximum value, with optional steps between valid values.

pages.title: Space
pages.desc: The QSpace Vue component fills all the available space inside of a flexbox DOM element.

pages.title: Spinners
pages.desc: The QSpinner and its derived Vue components are used to show the user a timely process is currently taking place. It gives the user the feeling the system is continuing to work for longer term activities.

pages.title: Splitter
pages.desc: The QSplitter Vue component allow containers to be split vertically and/or horizontally through a draggable separator bar.

pages.title: Stepper
pages.desc: The QStepper Vue component conveys progress through a sequence of numbered steps. It may also be used for navigation. It's usually useful when the user has to follow steps to complete a process, like in a wizard.

pages.title: Tab Panels
pages.desc: The QTabPanel Vue component is a way of displaying more information using less window real estate.

pages.title: Table
pages.desc: The QTable Vue component allows you to display data in a tabular manner and it's packed with a lot of related features. It's generally called a datatable.

pages.title: Tabs
pages.desc: The QTabs, QTab and QRouteTab Vue components are a way of helping the user navigate between pages or tab panels.

pages.title: Time Picker
pages.desc: The QTime component provides a method to input time.

pages.title: Timeline
pages.desc: The QTimeline Vue component displays a list of events in chronological order. It is typically a graphic design showing a long bar labelled with dates alongside itself and usually events.

pages.title: Toggle
pages.desc: The QToggle component is a basic element for user input. You can use it for turning settings, features or true/false inputs on and off.

pages.title: Toolbar
pages.desc: The QToolbar and QToolbarTitle Vue components are usually part of QHeader or QFooter, but it can be used anywhere on the page.

pages.title: Tooltip
pages.desc: The QTooltip Vue component is to be used when you want to offer the user more information about a certain area in your App. When hovering the mouse over the target element (or touching and holding on touch-capable devices), the tooltip will appear.

pages.title: Tree
pages.desc: The QTree is a highly configurable Vue component which displays hierarchical data, such as a table of contents in a tree structure.

pages.title: Uploader
pages.desc: The QUploader Vue component is a way for the user to upload files to a backend server.

pages.title: Video
pages.desc: The QVideo Vue components makes embedding a video like Youtube easy. It also resizes to fit the container by default.

pages.title: Virtual Scroll
pages.desc: The QVirtualScroll component renders a big list of items as the user scrolls in the container, keeping DOM tree clean and eating the lowest amount of memory possible.

pages.title: v-close-popup directive
pages.desc: Helper Vue directive when working with QDialog or QMenu.

pages.title: v-drop-zone directive
pages.desc: Vue directive that turns the DOM element it is applied to into a target for dropped files.

pages.title: v-intersection directive
pages.desc: Vue directive that uses Intersection Observer API to call a method when user scrolls and brings a component into or out of view.

pages.title: v-ripple directive
pages.desc: Vue directive for easily adding material ripples to your components and DOM elements.

pages.title: v-morph directive
pages.desc: Vue directive that morphs between DOM elements or even between the two states of the same DOM element.

pages.title: v-mutation directive
pages.desc: Vue directive that uses Mutation Observer API to watch for changes being made to the DOM tree.

pages.title: v-resize directive
pages.desc: Vue directive that uses Resize Observer API to call a method whenever the DOM element it is applied to changes its width or height.

pages.title: v-scroll directive
pages.desc: Vue directive which triggers an event when user scrolls.

pages.title: v-scroll-fire directive
pages.desc: Vue directive that triggers an event when user scrolls and brings a component into view.

pages.title: v-touch-hold directive
pages.desc: Vue directive which triggers an event when the user touches and holds on a component or element for a specified amount of time.

pages.title: v-touch-pan directive
pages.desc: Vue directive which triggers an event when the user drags the finger or mouse on a component or element.

pages.title: v-touch-repeat directive
pages.desc: Vue directive which triggers an event at specified intervals of time while the user touches and holds on a component or element.

pages.title: v-touch-swipe directive
pages.desc: Vue directive which triggers an event when the user swipes with the finger or mouse on a component or element.
